events.title: CAIS Inauguration Meetup
events.description: The club's inauguration and very first meetup, billed as “Carleton AI Meetup #1”.

events.title: Intro to Data Science Workshop
events.description: An introductory workshop for students new to data science and machine learning. Attendees were asked to bring a laptop.

events.title: Tech Talk: Navigating the Data Science Career Path
events.description: CAIS's first tech talk, with a speaker from Shopify, for everyone from first-year students getting into AI to master's students looking for research opportunities.

events.title: Visual Mapping of Data using Python
events.description: A hands-on tutorial on plotting datasets onto real maps with Pandas, Basemap and NumPy.

events.title: Info Table at Tory Junction
events.description: An info table with candy and a live visual-processing demo, introducing students to the club.

events.title: Winter Meet & Greet
events.description: The first event of Winter 2020: food, the exec team, and other students interested in AI.

events.title: Let's Talk: Computer Vision!
events.description: A talk on computer vision, presented by CAIS co-founder and past president Fahad Hayat and Carleton MCS student Omar Benismael.

events.title: Ethics of AI with Dr. Jim Davies
events.description: The club's first lecture: the ethics of AI, given by Dr. Jim Davies, a four-time TEDx speaker.

events.title: Expo Carleton 2020
events.description: CAIS introduced itself to incoming students at the online Expo Carleton, streaming its presentation live on Twitch.

events.title: Welcome to CAIS! Fall Meet & Greet
events.description: An online meet and greet with the whole exec team, previewing the semester's events and its competition.

events.title: Introduction to Python and Data Science
events.description: A beginner session on what data science is, Python basics, Kaggle and Jupyter notebooks.

events.title: First Kaggle Competition Submission
events.description: How to navigate Kaggle, then build and submit a first notebook for the CAIS X competition.

events.title: CAIS X – Fall 2020
events.description: CAIS's first Kaggle competition for Carleton students: teams of up to two forecast COVID-19 cases, recoveries and deaths by province. It ran until January 3, 2021, with 14 teams taking part.

events.title: Maximum Likelihood Estimation Lecture
events.description: Introduced Maximum Likelihood Estimation and derived it for the Bernoulli and Gaussian distributions, touching on the bias-variance dilemma along the way.

events.title: Feature Engineering Techniques
events.description: Basic feature engineering techniques for improving model performance: garbage in, garbage out.

events.title: Introduction to Scientific Python
events.description: The core data science toolkit: NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn and matplotlib.

events.title: Clustering: K-means vs. Gaussian Mixture Models
events.description: Unsupervised learning through K-means and Gaussian Mixture Models, and how Expectation-Maximization fits a GMM.

events.title: Dimensionality Reduction: PCA vs. LDA
events.description: Derived Principal Component Analysis and Linear Discriminant Analysis and compared their strengths and limits. Streamed live on Twitch.

events.title: CPA Ontario × CAIS: Power BI Workshop
events.description: A demonstration of the Power BI business analytics tool followed by hands-on practice, run with club sponsor CPA Ontario.

events.title: Expo Carleton 2021
events.description: CAIS joined Carleton's online fall orientation showcase to meet incoming students.

events.title: AI Coffee Hour 1: Meet & Greet
events.description: An informal chat introducing the team and the year's plans (workshops, CAIS X and the podcast), followed by an open discussion about machine learning.

events.title: Game Night
events.description: A first-week game night in the CAIS Discord, to meet new people and learn about the club.

events.title: Introduction to Scientific Python
events.description: NumPy, Pandas, scikit-learn and matplotlib for beginners.

events.title: AI Coffee Hour 2: Reinforcement Learning
events.description: An informal chat about reinforcement learning. No experience needed.

events.title: Linear Regression
events.description: What linear regression is, when it is useful and how it works, as part of a series preparing members for the CAIS X competition.

events.title: Academic Trivia Night
events.description: AI and machine learning trivia on Kahoot, with prizes for the top two players.

events.title: Linear Classification
events.description: An introduction to linear classifiers, focusing on logistic regression.

events.title: AI Coffee Hour 4: Spooky AI Applications
events.description: A Halloween-themed chat with the Systems and Computer Engineering Society (SCESoc) about the scary and unethical sides of AI and ML.

events.title: Feature Selection & Transformation
events.description: Techniques for selecting and transforming features to improve model quality and performance.

events.title: AI Coffee Hour 5: Positive AI Application
events.description: Guest speaker Vinyas Harish, an MD/PhD student at the University of Toronto, on positive applications of AI and machine learning.

events.title: CAIS X 2021–22
events.description: CAIS's annual beginner machine learning competition, open to Carleton, uOttawa, Algonquin and La Cité students: predict students' final grades. It ran until April 1, 2022.

events.title: AI Coffee Hour 1: Meet & Greet
events.description: The first event of Winter 2022: meet the team, recap the last semester and preview the next.

events.title: Intro to Neural Networks
events.description: The foundations of deep learning: how simple parts combine into neural networks that can model complex relationships.

events.title: Neural Networks Project 1: Build Your First Neural Network
events.description: Build, train and test a simple neural network that makes predictions from tabular data.

events.title: AI Coffee Hour 2: Thriving in Graduate School
events.description: Dr. Jason Bernard on getting into graduate school, and surviving and thriving once you are there.

events.title: Intro to Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)
events.description: The core ideas behind CNNs and the architectures behind image classification, object detection and segmentation.

events.title: Introduction to Natural Language Processing
events.description: The first workshop of Winter 2023: basic NLP libraries and common text pre-processing tasks.

events.title: Attention Mechanism in Deep Learning
events.description: Attention mechanisms for time-series forecasting, worked through a traffic-flow prediction example.

events.title: CAIS Hackathon 2023
events.description: CAIS's first hackathon: a free weekend of machine learning and AI building, with workshops on TensorFlow, NLP, computer vision and ChatGPT. ChatRoller and WLIT took the prizes.

events.title: Metrics 101
events.description: How to calculate and interpret metrics, with use cases for machine learning and data science projects.

events.title: CUSA Club Expo
events.description: Presenting the club to new students and recruiting new members.

events.title: Club Executive Meet and Greet
events.description: Meet the club executives and learn about the club's goals and our plans for the future

events.title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
events.description: Learn the fundamentals of AI: its history, the main types of algorithms, and how to keep learning.

events.title: CUHacking AI Workshop
events.description: Hackathon workshop on using Ollama and HuggingFace models in your projects, plus mentorship on site.

events.title: Build Your Own Neural Network
events.description: Beginner workshop on implementing neural networks and a demo on how to build your own model.

events.title: Using AI APIs
events.description: Learn how to use AI APIs to implement AI in your projects.

events.title: CAIS Icebreaker
events.description: Meet the CAIS executive team, learn about the club, and connect with students interested in AI.

events.title: CUSA Winter Club Expo
events.description: The exec team met students at CUSA's Frost Week expo and shared how CAIS is building an inclusive AI community on campus.

events.title: Workshop #1 – Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
events.description: An introductory workshop covering core AI concepts and real-world applications.

events.title: Workshop #2 – Vibe Coding vs Prompt Engineering
events.description: A workshop comparing vibe coding and prompt engineering in modern AI development.

events.title: Workshop #3 – What Are Large Language Models?
events.description: An introduction to large language models and how they power modern AI systems.

events.title: Building an AI Chatbot!
events.description: Learn how AI chatbots work using RAG and semantic search in LLM applications.

events.title: Training an AI Model!
events.description: Train your first machine learning model using Python in a hands-on session.

events.title: Project Showcase
events.description: A science-fair-style night to demo AI, ML, cybersecurity and software projects, with no pitches or judges. Run by Carleton Blueprint with cuHacking, CAIS, Carleton Cybersecurity, SCESoc and CCSS.

events.title: Innovation Hub Winter Pitch Night
events.location: Innovation Hub, Sprott School of Business
events.description: CAIS gave a guest presentation on artificial intelligence and the club's work at the Innovation Hub's Winter Pitch Night.

events.title: CAIS Hackathon 2.0
events.description: A 48-hour challenge with a $250 prize pool, building AI solutions to problems post-secondary students face. Registration filled to capacity. ThinkFirst, CUCognitive and Procrastination Bot took the top three spots.

events.title: cuHacking Workshop – How to Use Agentic AI to Build Neural Networks
events.description: A cuHacking workshop on using agentic AI to design and build neural networks.

events.title: CUSA Club Expo
events.description: Presenting the club to new students and recruiting new members.

events.title: Tech Club Expo
events.description: Showcasing CAIS alongside Carleton's other tech clubs and meeting students interested in AI.

events.title: FED Meet & Greet
events.description: Meeting students at the FED Meet & Greet, with free food and pizza.

events.title: CAIS Icebreaker
events.description: Come find out who we are and what we actually do. Free pizza, all years welcome, no experience needed.

events.title: Machine Learning Workshop at Hack the Hill III
events.location: Room C040, uOttawa (Hack the Hill III)
events.description: A practical introduction to machine learning at uOttawa's Hack the Hill III hackathon: the core ideas behind models, and how to bring ML into a hackathon project.

events.title: Tentative Event
events.description: More details soon!
